'''April 2001 Melbourne tournament (22 April)''' was a Star Wars CCG open held in Melbourne, Australia on 22 April 2001. [[Luca Costanzo]] won it. It is known from Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2162">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-27-melbourne-22-04-01d2162/ melbourne-22-04-01], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 27 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-27-melbourne-22-04-01d2162/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Luca Costanzo]]
